Package net.maswag.falcaun.abstraction

package net.maswag.falcaun.abstraction
Mappings between the concrete signals and the finite abstract alphabets used in automata learning.

SignalDiscretizer is the interface of such mappings. Its main implementations are NumericSULMapper, SignalAdapter, and the specification-guided NumericSULMapperWithSGA. The thresholds for the discretization are given by InputMapper and OutputMapper, which can be read from files with InputMapperReader and OutputMapperReader.
